_comment: Languages the meanings (glosses) can be shown in. To add one: copy en keys with `npm run i18n -- --missing <code>`, translate them into assets/i18n/<code>.json and add a line here. The game itself always speaks Turkish. Optional "font": the font family used for that language (load it in index.html and src/fonts.js). Optional "scale": bigger meaning text for scripts that look small at the same size.
